games.title: Ladder Phonics
games.desc_en: A full phonics course, not a single game. 35 sound groups in teaching order, from s a t up to past tense -ed, so you always know what comes next
games.desc_zh: 一套完整拼讀課程，唔係一隻遊戲。35 組音素按教學次序排好，由 s a t 行到過去式 -ed，下一堂教乜一睇就知

games.title: Advanced Word Builder
games.desc_en: For the child who reads cat but freezes at fantastic. Hear the long word, spot the missing chunk, then build it. 85 long words, 49 phonics chunks, plus prefixes and suffixes
games.desc_zh: 專為識讀 cat、但見到 fantastic 就停低嘅學生。聽個長字、捉出漏咗嘅組合、再砌返出嚟。85 個長字、49 個拼讀組合，連前綴同字尾
games.kw: prefix suffix root 前綴 字尾 詞根 長字 生字

games.title: Syllable Splitter
games.desc_en: Long words stop being scary once they can cut them. Find the vowels first, then split, using six real splitting rules instead of guessing
games.desc_zh: 長字一識切就唔再驚。先搵母音再落刀，用六條真正嘅切音節規則，唔係靠估
games.kw: 音節 syllable 拆字 切音節 分音節 長字 magic e le 開音節 閉音節 拼讀

games.title: Sound Catcher
games.desc_en: The child says the sound out loud and you judge it. Nothing to tap, so nobody can guess their way through. Then flip it: hear a word, tap the sound it starts with. Any Ladder Phonics groups
games.desc_zh: 細路要真係讀出個音，由你判，冇得估住撳。之後反轉：聽一隻字，撳返佢開頭個音。Ladder Phonics 組別任揀
games.kw: phonics 聽音 開頭音 first sound initial sound 字母音 letter sound say the sound 出聲 老師判 screen share digraph ch sh th qu group 組別 K2 K3 P1 入門 零基礎

games.desc_en: Upper and lower case, but the target always appears in the other form: see A, rescue a. Wrong taps just wobble so they can try again. Built for early years

games.title: Ladder Vocabulary · A1

games.title: Ladder Vocabulary · A2
games.desc_en: 684 A2 words, mapped to Cambridge A2 Key. Meaning, gap-fill sentences they type themselves and word parts, with a Known list that follows the student from lesson to lesson

games.title: Ladder Vocabulary · B1

games.title: Ladder Vocabulary · B2

games.desc_en: Proofreading on real text types, from an email to a speech script. Tap what looks wrong, choose the fix, and wrong taps are logged. Then paste their own writing into Check My Writing

games.desc_en: Most students can ask. Few answer well. Answer it trains the short answer that matches the question, then one real detail. Ask it, answer it, fix it, 157 items

games.title: Advice Studio
games.desc_en: Four ways to give advice, not just should: should / shouldn't, Why don't you…?, You'd better, If I were you, I'd. 18 everyday problems, from a headache to an angry friend. Choose, sort, build, then say it
games.desc_zh: 四種畀建議嘅講法，唔止 should：should／shouldn't、Why don't you…?、You'd better、If I were you, I'd。18 個日常情境，由頭痛到朋友嬲咗。揀、分類、砌句，最後講出嚟

games.desc_en: Type 0 to 3, thinking first. Students decide which type the situation needs before they touch a verb, then build it, then write it. Wrong answers name the exact mistake, like will after if

games.desc_en: a few / a little, many / much, some / any, fewer / less and more. Tick only the sets their school has taught. Every sentence uses A2 words or easier, so the noun never blocks the grammar
games.desc_zh: a few／a little、many／much、some／any、fewer／less 等等。只剔學校教咗嘅 set。所有句子淨係用 A2 或以下字彙，唔會因為唔識個名詞而答唔到

Word cards are grouped (symptoms, illnesses, feelings, how bad and how long). Wrong choices get a hint, never a penalty

games.title: Detective Dictation
games.desc_en: Dictation with a reason to listen. Hear the case, then fill in the report: who, what, when, where. Listening and spelling in one
games.desc_zh: 有目的嘅聽寫。聽案情，再填報告：邊個、乜嘢、幾時、喺邊。聽力同拼寫一次過練
games.kw: 聽力 listening 聽寫 dictation 默書 拼寫 spelling

games.title: Announcement Station
games.desc_en: Real-world listening: school, station, airport, supermarket and library announcements. Wrong answers point to the exact line that held the answer
games.desc_zh: 真實場景聽力：學校、車站、機場、超市、圖書館廣播。答錯會指返答案喺邊一句
games.kw: 聽力 listening 廣播 announcement 理解 comprehension 車站 station 機場 airport 超市 supermarket 圖書館 library 學校 school 日常

games.title: Number Ninja
games.desc_en: 13 or 30? Prices, times, dates and long numbers, where one wrong sound changes the whole answer
games.desc_zh: 13 定 30？價錢、時間、日期、長數字，錯一個音成個答案就唔同
games.kw: 聽力 listening 數字 number 13 30 thirteen thirty 價錢 price 時間 time 日期 date 電話 phone 數 聽數字

games.title: Tower of Sentences
games.desc_en: Each level gives a plain sentence and three target words. Use all three and the new sentence becomes a brick in their tower. Tap any target word for its meaning and an example
games.desc_zh: 每層畀一句最簡單嘅句子同三個目標字，用晒三個字寫新句，就變成塔嘅一磚。撳目標字睇解釋同例句
games.kw: 寫作 writing 砌句 sentence 長句 連接詞

games.title: The Chain Story Game
games.desc_en: Pick a theme, then one sentence each in turn. Stuck? Show Words hands them something to build on
games.desc_zh: 揀個主題，然後一人一句接落去。諗唔到就撳 Show Words，即刻有字用
games.kw: 寫作 writing 故事 story 接龍 連貫 creative

games.title: The Detective’s Notebook
games.desc_en: Three cases, three scenes each. Read the clues, write one sentence per scene with a template, and the notebook becomes a report in the right order
games.desc_zh: 三宗案，每宗三個現場。睇線索、跟範本每個現場寫一句，本筆記簿就變成一份次序啱嘅報告
games.kw: 寫作 writing 報告 report 敘事 順序 記錄

games.title: My Time Travel Journal
games.desc_en: Pick a time portal, answer the prompts, and it builds into a journal they can save. Past tense the whole way, without it feeling like a tense exercise
games.desc_zh: 揀個時空門，答完題目自動砌成一本可以儲低嘅日記。全程練過去式，但唔似做時態練習
games.kw: 寫作 writing 日記 journal diary 過去式 past 敘述

games.title: Restaurant Review Kitchen
games.desc_en: Pick the ingredients, then write the review. It tells them which tense this one needs before they start
games.desc_zh: 揀好材料先寫食評。落筆之前會講明呢篇要用邊個時態
games.kw: 寫作 writing 餐廳 restaurant cafe 食評 review 意見 形容詞 食物 food

games.title: Role-Play Writing Adventure
games.desc_en: Choose a character, then build the story in six steps: scene, problem, action, feeling, reason, lesson. A shape instead of a blank page
games.desc_zh: 揀個角色，然後六步砌故事：場景、出事、行動、感受、原因、教訓。畀個框架，唔係畀張白紙
games.kw: 寫作 writing 對白 dialogue 書信 letter email 角色

games.title: Presentation Script Builder
games.desc_en: Plan with Purpose, Audience and Tone, then write part by part: greeting, introduction, hook, main points, facts and closing. It checks structure, language features and comma splices, then times them reading it aloud
games.desc_zh: 先做 PAT（目的、觀眾、語氣），再逐段寫：問候、介紹、hook、重點、數據、結尾。會檢查結構、語言特點同 comma splice，最後計時讀出嚟
games.kw: PAT purpose audience tone signposting present perfect conditional 講稿 演講 presentation script 簡報 寫作 writing 演講 presentation 講稿 script 匯報 開場

games.title: Mini Business Tycoon Junior
games.desc_en: Ages 7 to 9. Students say what they want to do in English and you press the button, so every business decision is a spoken sentence. 10 days, with surprise event cards
games.desc_zh: 7–9 歲。學生用英文講想點做，你幫佢撳掣，所以每個生意決定都係一句講出口嘅英文。捱 10 日，有突發事件卡
games.kw: 理財 money 生意 business 成本 cost 收入 income 7-9歲

games.title: Mini Business Tycoon Super
games.desc_en: Ages 10 to 12. Every decision is still spoken, now with harder business English and real risks like spoiled stock
games.desc_zh: 10–12 歲。每個決定照樣要講出口，加埋更深嘅商業英文同貨物變壞呢類真實風險
games.kw: 理財 money 生意 business 決策 商業英文 10-12歲

games.title: Young Entrepreneur
games.desc_en: Eight business challenges. Pick who to sell to, plan the idea, count the money in English, then pitch it out loud
games.desc_zh: 八個創業任務。揀客群、計劃點做、用英文計數，最後開口 pitch
games.kw: 創業 entrepreneur 計劃書 business plan 寫作 理財 money

games.title: Creative Hustle Challenge
games.desc_en: 20 challenges, and each day throws in a twist. You grade the pitch, and money and reputation follow. 29 business words
games.desc_zh: 20 個任務，每日加一個突發狀況。你評佢個提案，錢同聲望跟住郁。29 個生意生字
games.kw: 創業 生意點子 idea 提案 pitch 理財 money

games.title: Group Interview Room
games.desc_en: Group discussion interviews, practised in a 1-to-1 lesson. You play the other members, tap each move the student makes, and save a report
games.desc_zh: 小組面試討論，喺 1 對 1 堂都練得。你扮其他組員，逐個動作撳低，完場儲存報告
games.kw: 小組 group 討論 discussion 升中面試 小組面試 interview 面試 題目 報告 1對1

games.title: English Class Helper
games.desc_en: First lesson setup: type the names, spin for who goes next, pick a topic. The list saves, so you only do it once
games.desc_zh: 第一堂開場：入名、轉盤抽人、揀題目。個名單存得低，做一次就夠
games.kw: 小組 group 第一堂 破冰 icebreaker 分組 開學

games.title: Classroom Interview Activity
games.desc_en: 30 questions and 10 mission cards. Every pair interviews at the same time, so the whole class is talking at once
games.desc_zh: 30 條問題、10 張任務卡。所有組同時進行，全班一齊講嘢
games.kw: 小組 group 訪問 interview 兩人 pair 同步

games.title: Zoo Detective: Who Am I?
games.desc_en: The class asks the yes/no questions and you answer, so the questions come from them, not you. Everyone asks once before anyone can guess
games.desc_zh: 全班問 yes/no 問題、你答，問題由學生出，唔係你出。每人問過一次先准估
games.kw: 動物 animal zoo 估 guess yes no question 小組 group 全班

games.title: Student Picker
games.desc_en: Random student, and it counts down who is left. Nobody gets picked twice before everyone has had a turn
games.desc_zh: 隨機抽學生，仲會顯示仲剩返幾多個。一輪之內唔會抽同一個人兩次
games.kw: 抽人 隨機 random picker 點名 全班 小組 課堂管理

games.title: Ladder Wheel
games.desc_en: Paste your questions and the wheel builds itself. Tap to remove what has been said, and save or load wheels
games.desc_zh: 貼上題目即生成轉盤；講過嘅一撳移走，轉盤可儲存同 Save/Load file
games.kw: 轉盤 wheel 隨機 random 抽題 抽人 自我介紹 self introduction 升中面試 interview warm up 熱身 破冰 ice breaker 句式 sentence frame 課堂工具

games.title: Big Text
games.desc_en: Classroom magnifier. Paste a word or sentence, one letter per cell, tap to draw syllable lines
games.desc_zh: 課堂放大器：貼字或句子，一格一個字母，撳一撳畫音節線
games.kw: 放大 大字 large type 音節 syllable 拆字 分音節 share screen 白板 課堂工具 貼句子

games.title: Guess What I Am
games.desc_en: You think of something, they find it with yes/no questions that must start with Do, Are, Can, Is, Does or Have. Question forms practised without a worksheet
games.desc_zh: 你諗定一樣嘢，學生用 Do／Are／Can／Is／Does／Have 開頭嘅 yes/no 問題估。唔使工作紙都練到問句
games.kw: 猜謎 估嘢 riddle guess 描述 describe 提問 question 一對一 1對1 小組 全班
